description: Walmart Pickup & Delivery from the terminal — reads via orchestra, cart changes via affiliate link only.

novel_features.name: Purchase history with filters
novel_features.description: PurchaseHistoryV3 persisted query with --type in-store/online, --status completed/in-progress, --search and cursor paging; read-only.

novel_features.name: Order detail with line items
novel_features.description: getOrder line items (name, item id, quantity, line price) plus subtotal, tax, fees and total; customer, address and payment fields are never emitted.

novel_features.name: Store-aware product search
novel_features.description: Parses the server-rendered search page for price, unit price, aisle, availability and pickup/delivery fulfillment at the session's store.

novel_features.name: Read-only guard and bot-challenge stop
novel_features.description: Client refuses non-GET requests and denylisted cart/checkout/slot/order mutations, and stops (no retry) on PerimeterX 412/418/429/456 or /blocked.

novel_features.name: Product availability at your store
novel_features.description: ItemById persisted query: price, unit price, stock, pickup/delivery/shipping status and seller; shopper location fields are never emitted.

novel_features.name: Nearby pickup stores
novel_features.description: nearByNodes query for a ZIP: store id, distance, address, pickup types and hours; view only, never sets a store.

novel_features.name: Cart view
novel_features.description: getCart GET with a supplied cart id: items, mode, store and slot-reserved flag; MergeAndGetCart and every cart mutation stay blocked.

novel_features.name: Search filters
novel_features.description: --filter type:value (e.g. brand:Great Value), --sort and --list-filters from the page's sort/filter facets.
